name: Norwegian Cruise Line® World Mastercard®

apr.notes: APR not available from page text; official product page was temporarily unavailable at last verification. See Bank of America for current APR.

credit_required.notes: Recommended credit score of at least 670 (per third-party reviews); not stated on the official product page.

base_rate.description: 1 WorldPoints® point per $1 spent on all other purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points for stateroom upgrades, travel discounts, exclusive redemption opportunities for last minute cruises, onboard credits, car rentals, hotel stays, cash and gift cards. Rewards begin at 2,500 points. Points expire 5 years after the month they are earned. Enrich your experience as a Bank of America customer with the BofA Rewards™ program — starting with a rewards bonus on every credit card purchase.

signup_bonus.description: Online Offer: Get 20,000 bonus points after you make $1,000 or more in purchases in the first 90 days of account opening — which can be redeemed for $200 off your next Norwegian cruise.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the U.S.

benefits.title: No Annual Fee
benefits.description: No annual fee for the card.

benefits.title: BofA Rewards™ Program Bonus
benefits.description: Enrich your experience as a Bank of America customer with the BofA Rewards™ program — starting with a rewards bonus on every credit card purchase. Visit BofA Rewards to learn more about eligibility and enrollment.

other: BofA Rewards™ program bonus with eligible Bank of America account
